tasks.prompt: A local SKILL.md package installer validates its checksum ledger before copying, but a user can delete both plugin manifests and the checksum ledger to bypass the gate. Fix this fail-open behavior so a stripped release cannot apply files, while a complete clean release still installs normally.
acceptance: Require the complete mandatory metadata set for every apply request, even when a nondefault source root is supplied
Reject the stripped package before creating any target directory or skill file
Retain successful installation and idempotent verification for an intact package
negative_controls: Treating an archive without all metadata as a development fixture during apply must fail
Reporting an integrity error after files were already copied must fail

tasks.prompt: A development task says 'No web, build Android UI', but saved context contains platform=web and focus=ui. The router suggests web-ui, and a forced web-feature pipeline is accepted. Implement explicit task-first platform exclusion and preserve later positive web requests.
acceptance: Report web as an explicitly excluded technology family while still permitting Android UI
Reject an explicitly forced web-feature pipeline and stale web platform context
Allow the later clause in 'No web for CLI, but build web UI' to re-enable web workflows
negative_controls: Allowing stale context or command flags to override a current explicit user exclusion must fail
Banning web unconditionally even after a later positive request must fail

tasks.prompt: An engineer requests 'No security audit, build responsive web UI', but an automation passes --pipeline security-fix. The old planner builds a security audit checklist anyway. Keep the plan read-only and reject the forbidden pipeline without blocking later explicitly requested security work.
acceptance: Reject the explicitly forbidden security-fix pipeline with a meaningful diagnostic
Continue to select web UI for the main task without the forbidden audit
Allow a later explicit request for a security audit to supersede the earlier negative clause
negative_controls: Treating pipeline command arguments as authority over explicit user constraints must fail
Claiming the planner has run or validated a security audit must fail

tasks.prompt: A Russian engineering request such as 'Без веба: сделай Android навигацию' should route to a navigation skill, while 'Не нужен веб, исправь API контракты' should route to a contract skill. Distinguish case forms from unrelated words such as 'вебинар'.
acceptance: Handle common Russian grammatical forms and transliterated platform terms without broad irrelevant matches
Route Android navigation to the specialized navigation skill while excluding web-specific skills
Route API contracts to the specialized contract skill and preserve deterministic output
negative_controls: Matching 'вебинар' as a ban on web tooling without a real web mention must fail
Always selecting only the generic Android UI or API design skill must fail
